verdict.rationale: Beamer is a changelog, feedback and roadmap tool, so a feedback-to-tasks approval gate is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows feedback collection, prioritization and public/private roadmaps. Nothing documents reviewing or approving a task's scope before work starts, and prioritization and roadmaps are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can review and approve the scope of a task before any work begins on it
